sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr.S.K.Parhi, Asc
 Coram:
 The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Aditya Kumar Mohapatra
 Order
Order No. 08.05.2025
06. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement
 (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

3. This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioners for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Section 376 (2) (n) of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act of the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Jajpur in C.T.(Special) (POCSO)
No.34 of 2021 arising out of Panikoili P.S. Case No.45 of 2021.
4.

It is stated by learned counsel for the petitioners that the principal accused, namely, Kalua @
Prasanta Malik who was directed to surrender in court below and move an application for bail in ABLAPL No.7362 of 2022 vide order dated 20.07.2022 had in fact surrendered in court below and released on bail.
He further contended that before the principal accused was surrendered, he was arrested by the police and after remaining in custody, he was enlarged on bail by the learned trial court.
So far as the present petitioners are concerned, it is stated that the petitioner No.1 is the brother-in-law of the principal accused and petitioner No.2 is the sister-in- law of the accused.
Further he contended that the petitioners have no role in the alleged crime.

5. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstance of the case, although I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioners, however it is observed that, in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail before the learned court in seisin over the matter within a period of Raghunath Malik And Another vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167471980/
1

sentences.text: three weeks from today, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the learned Magistrate may deem just and proper.
6. It is further directed that the bail granted to the Petitioners is subject to verification of the fact that the principal accused- Kalua @ Prasanta Malik has been released on bail.
In the event, the principal accused- Kalua @ Prasanta Malik has not been released on bail, then this order stands automatically revoked.
7. The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
8. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
